title: Message
description: A message as written, and as an operator would key it.

original.description: The message as written, before any encoding. Any text. Carried unchanged.

encoded.description: The message as keyed for transmission: A-Z only, with word breaks, punctuation and numbers spelled out or dropped.

separator.description: How encoded marks word breaks: x (the letter X, classical and Enigma operators), z (the letter Z, M-209 operators), or spelled (no separator letter; breaks and punctuation spelled as words, or omitted). Set by the operator that prepared the message.
